thread:
Priyanka (CS): Quick kickoff for Meridian Labs private/VPC onboarding. Open items: TGW attachment + route propagation, firewall SR for outbound to Redwood control plane, CMK policy to permit cross-account ops, and audit logs export to their S3 with 365d retention. Renewal watch: trial usage at ~22% of expected commit; flag AE at 40%.

Omar (Customer): TGW will be used. Egress CIDR is 34.88.0.0/16. Bucket meridian-redwood-logs created with prefix redwood/audit. We'll allow PutObject to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger when you confirm ARN. Monthly CMK rotation fine.

Bea (NetEng): Need TGW attachment ID, route table IDs, and the private endpoint subnet IDs. For firewall SR propose opening outbound TCP 443 to 111.222.10.0/24 (control) and UDP 5263 to 111.222.11.0/24 (telemetry). Do we want SSH from bastion limited to specific IPs?

Derek (Security): Current CMK policy denies the Redwood role. Draft snippet I can post to ticket MDN-77 to allow specific role: {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}. Also suggest enabling CloudTrail log file validation for the 365d retention. Note cost impact 6 audit retention in account health.

OpsBot: Ticket MDN-77 created: "meridian private deploy - TGW routes, firewall SR, CMK update" assigned to Bea and Derek.

Priyanka (CS): Action items: 1) Omar post TGW attachment + route table IDs + bastion IPs (Omar). 2) Bea open firewall SR and confirm healthcheck path (Bea). 3) Derek post CMK policy diff and request final ARN if different (Derek). I'll add renewal watch to account health dashboard. Target smoke test next Wed 08:30 PST.

Omar (Customer): Posting TGW attachment att-0a1b2c3d and route table rtb-0f1e2d3c now. Bastion IPs: 54.201.45.22, 54.201.45.23. I added PutObject permission to meridian-redwood-logs for arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Logger.

Bea (NetEng): SR-8812 opened for outbound 111.222.10.0/24:443 and 111.222.11.0/24:5263. Healthcheck configured to /healthz on 30s interval. Will update MDN-77 with SR link when approved.

Derek (Security): Posted CMK policy patch in MDN-77 and requested confirmation that alias alias/meridian-priv-cmk exists. Also recommended 90-day rotation as alternative for higher security posture.

Priyanka (CS): Thanks everyone 10. Noting risks: CMK alias mismatch and audit retention cost impact. I'll escalate AE if usage hits 40% before next check. Closing thread unless blockers surface.
